title: Implement db.py: SQLite schema and query layer
description:
Create src/psp_etl/db.py implementing:
- Schema creation (images, entries, string_analysis, strings, primary_images, parse_errors tables + all indexes from DESIGN.md)
- Database class with connection management (context manager)
- insert_image(), insert_entry(), insert_string_analysis(), insert_strings() methods
- Query methods: query_entries(filters), get_best_entries(gen, type_id), get_stats()
- All queries should use parameterized SQL
- Use pathlib for database path, default to data/psp-etl.db relative to project root

comments.author: driver
comments.content: Design decision: DB uses PRAGMA user_version for schema versioning. On version mismatch, drop and recreate all tables. No migration library. All data is re-derivable from ROMs via ingest+analyze.

comments.author: driver
comments.content: Design decision: string_analysis table keyed by blob_sha256 (not entry_id) for blob-centric analysis. Added entropy REAL column. See .design/psp-etl-architecture.md for full modified schema.
